# MCP Marketplace Submission Templates

*Generated by Claude claude-sonnet-4-20250514 via Windsurf Cascade. Reviewed by gabiup2, 2026-05-25.*
*Status update: 2026-06-29*

Use these templates to submit TaskChampion MCP to community registries.
The Official MCP Registry is handled automatically via `./dev.sh publish`
and the GitHub Actions `publish.yml` workflow.

**Before each release tag**, work through [`docs/manuals/release_checklist.md`](manuals/release_checklist.md).

## Additional Marketplaces to Target

The following marketplaces were identified as high-priority targets for future submissions:

### Apigene MCP Directory
- **URL:** <https://apigene.ai/mcp/official>
- **Listings:** 251+ vendor-verified MCP servers
- **Why target:** Security scanning, vendor verification, one-click installation, gateway integration
- **Status:** CONSIDERED BUT NOT PURSUED
- **Decision:** Research confirmed Apigene only accepts vendor-verified official servers from companies (e.g., GitHub, Salesforce, Google). Community-maintained projects are not accepted.
- **Criteria:** Requires server to be maintained by actual vendor, hosted on vendor's official domain, with direct vendor support.
- **Research date:** 2026-06-29
- **Research details:** See `docs/mcpservers_submission_data.md` for detailed findings

### PulseMCP
- **URL:** <https://www.pulsemcp.com>
- **Listings:** 20,110+ servers (updated daily)
- **Why target:** Large directory, enriched metadata (popularity, security analysis), trending focus
- **Status:** AUTO-INGESTED from Official MCP Registry (no direct submission needed)
- **Timeline:** Appears within 7 days of registry publication
- **Expedite:** Email hello@pulsemcp.com with server name and namespace (io.github.GabiUp2/taskchampion-mcp)
- **Note:** PulseMCP is an aggregator that pulls from the Official MCP Registry automatically

### mcpservers.org
- **URL:** <https://mcpservers.org>
- **Listings:** 4,000+ servers
- **Why target:** Aggregates from npm, PyPI, and GitHub
- **Status:** SUBMITTED (2026-06-29) - Free submission, awaiting approval
- **Submission method:** Web form at <https://mcpservers.org/submit>
- **Form data:** See `docs/mcpservers_submission_data.md`
- **Timeline:** Typically same-day approval (per community reports)

### Cline MCP Marketplace
- **Status:** Research needed for URL and submission process
- **Priority:** Medium

### MCPMarket
- **URL:** <https://market-mcp.com>
- **Listings:** 37,620+ servers across 23+ categories
- **Why target:** Largest catalog, Cline AI agent integration, one-click installation
- **Status:** Ready to submit (form data prepared)
- **Submission method:** Web form at <https://market-mcp.com/submit-mcp>
- **Form data:** See `docs/mcpmarket_submission_data.md`
- **Review:** All submissions reviewed before publishing

## 1. mcp.so — GitHub Issue Submission

> Submit at: https://github.com/chatmcp/mcp-directory/issues/new

**Title:** `[New Server] TaskChampion MCP — Taskwarrior 3.x task management`

**Body:**

```markdown
### Server Name
TaskChampion MCP

### Description
MCP server for Taskwarrior 3.x, TaskChampion, and Timewarrior. Read, create, modify, and manage tasks and time entries from any LLM assistant. Features schema-based validation, role-based permissions (CONTRIBUTOR/GENERATOR/MANAGER), and comprehensive security controls.

### Transport
stdio

### Auth
None (local server)

### Tools
- `list_tasks` — List tasks matching optional filter expressions
- `get_task` — Get full task details by UUID
- `search_tasks` — Search tasks by keyword or regex
- `get_projects` — List all project names
- `get_tags` — List all tags
- `get_schema_info` — Get schema definition for LLM context
- `annotate_task` — Add annotation to a task
- `modify_task` — Modify fields on an existing task
- `create_task` — Create a new task with schema validation
- `complete_task` — Mark task as done
- `delete_task` — Delete a task
- `undo_last_action` — Undo last Taskwarrior operation
- `sync_tasks` — Trigger task sync via TaskChampion
- `get_time_status` — Check Timewarrior tracking status
- `get_time_summary` — Get time tracking summary

### Config Snippet
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "taskchampion": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["taskchampion-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Homepage
https://github.com/GabiUp2/TaskChampion_MCP

### Repository
https://github.com/GabiUp2/TaskChampion_MCP

### License
Apache-2.0
```

## 2. awesome-mcp-servers — Pull Request

> Submit at: https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers

Fork the repo, add the following line to the appropriate category table
(likely **Productivity & Project Management** or **Data & File Systems**),
and open a PR.

**Table row to add:**

```markdown
| [TaskChampion MCP](https://github.com/GabiUp2/TaskChampion_MCP) | MCP server for Taskwarrior 3.x — read, create, modify tasks and track time via Timewarrior. Schema-based validation, role-based permissions. | [GabiUp2](https://github.com/GabiUp2) |
```

**PR title:** `feat: add TaskChampion MCP (Taskwarrior 3.x task management)`

**PR body:**

```markdown
## New Server: TaskChampion MCP

**What it does:** MCP server that wraps Taskwarrior 3.x (TaskChampion) and
Timewarrior CLI tools, exposing them as structured MCP tools for any AI assistant.

**Key features:**
- 35 tools spanning full task lifecycle, time tracking, runtime
  reconfiguration, and capability introspection. Headline tools:
  `list_tasks`, `create_task`, `modify_task`, `complete_task`,
  `delete_task`, `start_task` / `stop_task`, `batch_create_tasks`,
  `bulk_modify`, `get_task_report`, `get_time_summary`,
  `set_active_schema`, `set_role` (downgrade-only), `reload_configuration`,
  `get_runtime_capabilities`. Plus an 8-tool onboarding surface for first-run
  schema setup.
- Schema-based task validation with five bundled presets (minimal, GTD,
  scrum, kanban, plus a real-world `authors_custom_example`)
- Role-based permissions with strict elevation-asymmetry
  (CONTRIBUTOR / GENERATOR / MANAGER; self-elevation forbidden via MCP per ADR 17)
- Auto-generated schemas from existing tasks + taxonomy files
- Runtime reload — no IDE restart required after config changes (ADR 19)
- Rate limiting, structured audit logging with stable JSON-Lines schema
  (ADR 13), input sanitisation, dry-run + confirmation flow for destructive
  operations

**Install:** `pip install taskchampion-mcp` / `uvx taskchampion-mcp`
**License:** Apache-2.0
**Python:** 3.10+
**Requires:** Taskwarrior 3.x
```

## 3. smithery.ai

> Submit at: https://smithery.ai

Smithery auto-detects from GitHub and npm. To publish:

```bash
npm install -g @smithery/cli
smithery publish --github GabiUp2/TaskChampion_MCP
```

If the CLI isn't available, submit via the web form at https://smithery.ai/new
with the same information from the mcp.so template above.

---

## 4. glama.ai/mcp

> URL: https://glama.ai/mcp

Glama auto-crawls GitHub repositories that contain MCP configurations.
Having `server.json` in the repo root should be sufficient for auto-discovery.

If manual submission is needed, use their web form with:
- **Name:** TaskChampion MCP
- **Repo:** https://github.com/GabiUp2/TaskChampion_MCP
- **Transport:** stdio
- **Description:** MCP server for Taskwarrior 3.x task management + Timewarrior time tracking
